scripts.start: node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');const o=execSync('find .next/standalone -name \"*.css\" -print -quit').toString().trim();if(!o){console.error('REFUSING TO START: the standalone bundle has no stylesheet. Run: npm run postbuild');process.exit(1)}" && HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0 node .next/standalone/apps/web/server.js
scripts.postbuild: rm -rf .next/standalone/apps/web/.next/static && cp -rT .next/static .next/standalone/apps/web/.next/static && { cp -rT public .next/standalone/apps/web/public 2>/dev/null || true; } && test -n "$(find .next/standalone -name '*.css' -print -quit)"
